title: Quarterly Product Forecast Brief
brief: Prepare a concise quarterly sales and profitability forecast for the Harborlight countertop water filter.

delegate.scenario: You are the marketing manager at fictional home-goods company Northline Works, preparing a Q3 2026 planning brief for the sales director and finance partner. They will use it in a review meeting on June 10 to set inventory and campaign priorities.
delegate.inputs:
Q3 planning notes — Harborlight filter
Current shelf price: $129.00. Unit cost: $58.00. Q2 actual sales: 4,800 units. Retail partners say interest is strongest in the Northeast; a competitor cut its comparable filter price to $119 in May.

Q3 unit forecast by month:
| Month | Units |
| --- | ---: |
| July | 1,900 |
| August | 2,200 |
| September | 2,400 |

Forecast total: 6,500 units. Keep price at $129 for the base case. Gross profit estimate in the draft: $461,500, before marketing spend.

Proposed campaign spend:
| Channel | Budget |
| --- | ---: |
| Retail co-op | $18,000 |
| Paid search | $12,500 |
| Creator demos | $9,500 |
Total campaign budget: $42,000.

The retailer launch calendar lists the Harborlight Q3 campaign start as 06/15/2026. In the sales team email, Morgan wrote: "We're aligned to start the Harborlight Q3 campaign on 06/22/2026." Inventory booking is due June 12.
delegate.goal: Give the planning team a decision-ready forecast that clearly separates supported figures from assumptions and flags anything requiring confirmation.

criteria.text: States that the brief is for the sales director and finance partner making Q3 planning decisions.
Uses the supplied sales, pricing, cost, market, and campaign information without inventing unsupported facts.
Presents a concise, scannable forecast with unit outlook, profitability, and recommended priorities.
Keeps the response within a clearly stated short format and distinguishes assumptions from confirmed inputs.
Checks source figures and timeline details for internal consistency, and flags unresolved conflicts rather than choosing silently.

traps.description: The campaign budget total of $42,000 conflicts with the channel budgets, which sum to $40,000.
The retailer calendar gives a campaign start of 06/15/2026, while the sales team email gives 06/22/2026.
evidence: start the Harborlight Q3 campaign on 06/22/2026.

delegate.exemplar: Prepare a concise, one-page Q3 2026 forecast brief for the sales director and finance partner to use in inventory and campaign planning. Use only the supplied figures and market notes; do not add unsupported assumptions. Include a scannable table of monthly units, the base-case revenue and gross profit outlook, and a few practical priorities. Label assumptions separately from confirmed inputs. Reconcile calculations to the source figures and check dates and other planning details for conflicts; flag anything unresolved for confirmation instead of silently choosing a version.
